pages.text: Every piece of lost technology is held by something that will fight to keep it. Beat it and it drops a $(bold)Blueprint$() — the knowledge of how the thing was made.$(br2)Use the Blueprint and you can build that technology. Nobody else can until they learn it too.

Knowledge is a thing you can hand to someone. Trade Blueprints, gift them, loot them from the fallen. Civilization recovers by sharing what it recovers.$(br2)See $(l:patchouli:tech/how_blueprints_work)Blueprints & Recovery$() for the ladder.
